subject: Weekly turn-in: account health pulse + 15m precall
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Cc: Susan Park <susan@acme-analytics.com>
Date: Mon, 20 May 2028 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Weekly turn-in: account health pulse + 15m precall

Team —

Quick reminder: today’s weekly turn-in window closes EOD PT. I pulled the latest grid (attached) and flagged a handful of accounts that need immediate stage or evidence updates before the 11:00 PT precall. Please do the following before the pre-call: 

- Update stage and close probability in HubSpot for any active opportunities you own (see deal IDs in the grid).
- Add evidence links or attach the attestation document to the turn-in row for each account (SOC2, contract notes, PO status).
- If you expect the account to slip or require a credits/discount ask, include a 1-line rationale in the comments column.

Precall logistics (11:00–11:15 PT, short):
- 11:00 — lockline: owners call out any deals moving to Commit or at-risk
- 11:06 — rapid risk tagging and mitigation owner
- 11:10 — decision / next step (hold, escalate, or move to commit)

I’ve cc’d Susan from Acme Analytics to surface one specific evidence ask — Susan, if you can drop the finance PO confirmation into the shared folder today that would clear the block on RW-ACME-0021.

Attachments: turnin_grid_Q2.xlsx (grid with owners + evidence column), account_health_snapshot_Acme.pdf (summary for Acme).

Thanks — please nudge if anything looks off.

Neha Kapoor
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
neha@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>

Neha / all —

Quick clarifying Q: for deals where legal review is still open (e.g., RW-EDU-009), do we mark as "Commit" if procurement signoff is expected this week but legal has outstanding redlines? My recommendation would be: 

- Mark as "Commit - contingent" and add the legal owner + expected clear date in the comments column.

I updated the grid with a provisional entry for RW-EDU-009 and attached a short note (see attached 15m_precall_agenda.docx stub). If we want to standardize the "contingent" handling, happy to codify a one-liner for the admin column so reviewers can triage faster.

—Marissa
RevOps Manager
marissa@redwood.com

From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Weekly turn-in: account health pulse + 15m precall

Thanks — all good notes. Quick confirmations before 11:00 PT: 

- Ben: treat RW-ACME-0021 as Commit once Susan drops the PO; I’ll mark the deal as "QA pass" in the evidence column when the PDF is in the shared folder.
- Marissa: agree with your "Commit - contingent" pattern; I’ve added a one-line standard to the admin column:
  "Commit - contingent — list outstanding blocker(s) + owner + ETA"
- Karthik / Marcus: please prioritize any deals that are >$200k and lack evidence links — call them out in the first 3 min of the precall.

I’ll run the 11:00 call and share the short readout to the revenue channel after the decision window.

Neha
Head of Revenue Operations
neha@redwood.com
